02780:     fun openOnRemoteDevice(item: FileItem) {
02781:         val parentDir = if (item.path.contains('/')) {
02782:             item.path.substringBeforeLast('/').ifEmpty { "/" }
02783:         } else if (item.path.contains('\\')) {
02784:             item.path.substringBeforeLast('\\').ifEmpty { "\\" }
02785:         } else {
02786:             _currentPath.value
02787:         }
02788:
02789:         val req1 = JsonObject().apply {
02790:             addProperty("action", "open")
02791:             addProperty("path", parentDir)
02792:             addProperty("file", item.name)
02793:             addProperty("target", item.path)
02794:         }
02795:         webSocket?.send(req1.toString())
02796:
02797:         val req2 = JsonObject().apply {
02798:             addProperty("action", "open")
02799:             addProperty("path", item.path)
02800:             addProperty("target", item.path)
02801:         }
02802:         webSocket?.send(req2.toString())
02803:
02804:         val req3 = JsonObject().apply {
02805:             addProperty("action", "openfile")
02806:             addProperty("path", item.path)
02807:             addProperty("file", item.name)
02808:         }
02809:         webSocket?.send(req3.toString())
02810:
02811:         _statusMessage.value = "Abriendo ${item.name} en el equipo remoto..."
02812:     }

02814:     fun deleteItem(item: FileItem) {
02815:         scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
02816:             try {
02817:                 validateRemoteEntryName(item.name)
02818:                 val parent = remoteParent(item.path)
02819:
02820:                 if (!isConnected()) {
02821:                     connect()
02822:                     var waitMs = 0
02823:                     while (!_connectionState.value && waitMs < 5000) {
02824:                         delay(100)
02825:                         waitMs += 100
02826:                     }
02827:                 }
02828:
02829:                 check(_connectionState.value && webSocket != null) { "El túnel de archivos no está conectado" }
02830:
02831:                 val reqIdStr = Random.nextInt(100000, 999999).toString()
02832:
02833:                 val rmReq = JsonObject().apply {
02834:                     addProperty("action", "rm")
02835:                     addProperty("reqid", reqIdStr)
02836:                     addProperty("id", reqIdStr)
02837:                     addProperty("path", parent)
02838:                     addProperty("file", item.name)
02839:                     add("files", gson.toJsonTree(listOf(item.name)))
02840:                     add("delfiles", gson.toJsonTree(listOf(item.name)))
02841:                     if (item.isDir) {
02842:                         addProperty("rec", 1)
02843:                         addProperty("recursive", true)
02844:                         addProperty("recurse", true)
02845:                     }
02846:                 }
02847:                 webSocket?.send(rmReq.toString())
02848:
02849:                 val dfReq = JsonObject().apply {
02850:                     addProperty("action", if (item.isDir) "deletefolder" else "deletefile")
02851:                     addProperty("path", item.path)
02852:                     addProperty("reqid", reqIdStr)
02853:                     addProperty("id", reqIdStr)
02854:                     if (item.isDir) {
02855:                         addProperty("recursive", true)
02856:                     }
02857:                 }
02858:                 webSocket?.send(dfReq.toString())
02859:
02860:                 savedFileContents.remove(item.path)
02861:                 _statusMessage.value = "Eliminación solicitada: ${item.name}"
02862:
02863:                 delay(600)
02864:                 if (isConnected()) {
02865:                     listDirectory(_currentPath.value)
02866:                 }
02867:             } catch (e: Exception) {
02868:                 Log.e("MeshFilesDelete", "No se pudo solicitar el borrado de ${item.path}", e)
02869:                 _statusMessage.value = "Error al eliminar: ${e.localizedMessage}"
02870:             }
02871:         }
02872:     }

02874:     fun deleteRemoteFilePath(fullPath: String) {
02875:         scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
02876:             try {
02877:                 val fileName = fullPath.substringAfterLast('/')
02878:                 val parent = if (fullPath.contains('/')) {
02879:                     val p = fullPath.substringBeforeLast('/')
02880:                     if (p.isEmpty()) "/" else p
02881:                 } else "/"
02882:
02883:                 val reqIdStr = Random.nextInt(100000, 999999).toString()
02884:
02885:                 val rmReq = JsonObject().apply {
02886:                     addProperty("action", "rm")
02887:                     addProperty("reqid", reqIdStr)
02888:                     addProperty("id", reqIdStr)
02889:                     addProperty("path", parent)
02890:                     addProperty("file", fileName)
02891:                     add("files", gson.toJsonTree(listOf(fileName)))
02892:                     add("delfiles", gson.toJsonTree(listOf(fileName)))
02893:                 }
02894:                 webSocket?.send(rmReq.toString())
02895:
02896:                 val dfReq = JsonObject().apply {
02897:                     addProperty("action", "deletefile")
02898:                     addProperty("path", fullPath)
02899:                     addProperty("reqid", reqIdStr)
02900:                     addProperty("id", reqIdStr)
02901:                 }
02902:                 webSocket?.send(dfReq.toString())
02903:
02904:                 delay(500)
02905:                 if (isConnected()) {
02906:                     listDirectory(_currentPath.value)
02907:                 }
02908:             } catch (e: Exception) {
02909:                 Log.e("MeshFilesUpload", "Error deleting remote file $fullPath: ${e.localizedMessage}", e)
02910:             }
02911:         }
02912:     }
02913:
02914:     fun renameItem(item: FileItem, newName: String) {
02915:         val parentDir = if (item.path.contains('/')) {
02916:             item.path.substringBeforeLast('/').ifEmpty { "/" }
02917:         } else if (item.path.contains('\\')) {
02918:             item.path.substringBeforeLast('\\')
02919:         } else {
02920:             _currentPath.value
02921:         }
02922:         val cleanParent = if (parentDir == "/") "/" else parentDir.trimEnd('/')
02923:         val newPath = if (cleanParent == "/") "/$newName" else "$cleanParent/$newName"
02924:
02925:         scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
02926:             try {
02927:                 validateRemoteEntryName(item.name)
02928:                 validateRemoteEntryName(newName)
02929:
02930:                 if (!isConnected()) {
02931:                     connect()
02932:                     var waitMs = 0
02933:                     while (!_connectionState.value && waitMs < 5000) {
02934:                         delay(100)
02935:                         waitMs += 100
02936:                     }
02937:                 }
02938:
02939:                 check(_connectionState.value && webSocket != null) { "El túnel de archivos no está conectado" }
02940:
02941:                 val reqIdStr = Random.nextInt(100000, 999999).toString()
02942:
02943:                 val renameReq = JsonObject().apply {
02944:                     addProperty("action", "rename")
02945:                     addProperty("reqid", reqIdStr)
02946:                     addProperty("id", reqIdStr)
02947:                     addProperty("path", cleanParent.ifEmpty { "/" })
02948:                     addProperty("oldfile", item.path)
02949:                     addProperty("newfile", newPath)
02950:                     addProperty("oldpath", item.path)
02951:                     addProperty("newpath", newPath)
02952:                     addProperty("oldname", item.name)
02953:                     addProperty("newname", newName)
02954:                 }
02955:                 webSocket?.send(renameReq.toString())
02956:
02957:                 val savedContent = savedFileContents.remove(item.path)
02958:                 if (savedContent != null) {
02959:                     savedFileContents[newPath] = savedContent
02960:                 }
02961:
02962:                 _statusMessage.value = "Renombrado a: $newName"
02963:                 delay(600)
02964:                 if (isConnected()) {
02965:                     listDirectory(_currentPath.value)
02966:                 }
02967:             } catch (e: Exception) {
02968:                 Log.e("MeshFilesRename", "Error al renombrar ${item.path} a $newName", e)
02969:                 _statusMessage.value = "Error al renombrar: ${e.localizedMessage}"
02970:             }
02971:         }
02972:     }

02974:     fun clearStatus() {
02975:         _statusMessage.value = null
02976:     }
02977:
02978:     fun disconnect(resetPath: Boolean = false) {
02979:         isUserDisconnect = true
02980:         copyingSourcePath = null
02981:         copyingDestPath = null
02982:         try {
02983:             copyingFileOutputStream?.close()
02984:         } catch (_: Exception) {}
02985:         copyingFileOutputStream = null
02986:         copyingTempFile?.delete()
02987:         copyingTempFile = null
02988:         readingFilePath = null
02989:         readingBuffer = null
02990:         _fileReadingProgress.value = null
02991:         _activeTransfers.value = emptyList()
02992:
02993:         webSocket?.close(1000, "Disconnecting files")
02994:         webSocket = null
02995:         _connectionState.value = false
02996:         _fileList.value = emptyList()
02997:         if (resetPath) {
02998:             _currentPath.value = "/"
02999:         }
03000:         _clipboardItem.value = null
03001:         clipboardNodeId = null
03002:         _fileContent.value = null
03003:         onStateChanged?.invoke()
03004:     }
03005:
03006:     fun onNetworkChanged() {
03007:         if (!isUserDisconnect && !isConnected()) {
03008:             connect()
03009:         }
03010:     }
03011:
03012:     private fun formatSize(size: Long): String {
03013:         if (size <= 0) return "0 B"
03014:         val units = arrayOf("B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB")
03015:         val digitGroups = (log10(size.toDouble()) / log10(1024.0)).toInt()
03016:         return String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%.1f %s", size / 1024.0.pow(digitGroups.toDouble()), units[digitGroups])
03017:     }
03018: }
03019:
03020: class FileRelayClient {
03021:
03022:     companion object {
03023:         var activeInstance: FileRelayClient? = null
03024:     }
03025:
03026:     private val scope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO + Job())
03027:     private val sessions = ConcurrentHashMap<String, FileSession>()
03028:
03029:     private val _activeNodes = MutableStateFlow<Set<String>>(emptySet())
03030:     val activeNodesFlow: StateFlow<Set<String>> = _activeNodes.asStateFlow()
03031:
03032:     private val _sessionsStatus = MutableStateFlow<Map<String, SessionStatus>>(emptyMap())
03033:     val fileSessionsStatusFlow: StateFlow<Map<String, SessionStatus>> = _sessionsStatus.asStateFlow()
03034:
03035:     init {
03036:         activeInstance = this
03037:     }
03038:
03039:     private fun cleanKey(nodeId: String): String {
03040:         return if (nodeId.startsWith("node//")) {
03041:             nodeId.substring(6)
03042:         } else if (nodeId.startsWith("node/")) {
03043:             nodeId.substring(5)
03044:         } else {
03045:             nodeId
03046:         }.trimStart('/').trim()
03047:     }
03048:
03049:     fun updateSessionsStatus() {
03050:         val map = sessions.mapKeys { cleanKey(it.key) }.mapValues { entry ->
03051:             val sess = entry.value
03052:             when {
03053:                 sess.isConnected() -> SessionStatus.CONNECTED
03054:                 sess.fileList.value.isNotEmpty() && !sess.isUserDisconnect -> SessionStatus.DISCONNECTED_WITH_BUFFER
03055:                 else -> SessionStatus.NONE
03056:             }
03057:         }
03058:         _sessionsStatus.value = map
03059:         updateActiveNodes()
03060:     }
03061:
03062:     fun updateActiveNodes() {
03063:         val active = sessions.entries
03064:             .filter { it.value.isConnected() }
03065:             .map { cleanKey(it.key) }
03066:             .toSet()
03067:         _activeNodes.value = active
03068:     }
03069:
03070:     @Synchronized
03071:     fun getSession(meshClient: MeshCentralClient, nodeId: String): FileSession {
03072:         val key = cleanKey(nodeId)
03073:         return sessions.getOrPut(key) {
03074:             FileSession(nodeId = key, meshClient = meshClient, scope = scope).also { sess ->
03075:                 sess.onStateChanged = { updateSessionsStatus() }
03076:             }
03077:         }
03078:     }
03079:
03080:     fun isConnectedToNode(nodeId: String): Boolean {
03081:         val session = sessions[cleanKey(nodeId)]
03082:         return session?.isConnected() ?: false
03083:     }
